'''Juri Rappsilber''' (born 1971) is a German [[chemist]] in the area of [[mass spectrometry]] and [[proteomics]].

==Career==

Rappsilber studied chemistry at [[Technische Universität Berlin]], [[University of Strathclyde]], and with [[Tom Rapoport]], [[Harvard Medical School]]. In 2001, he earned his [[Ph.D.]] in Proteomics jointly from [[European Molecular Biology Laboratory|EMBL Heidelberg]] and the [[Goethe University Frankfurt]] working in the laboratory of [[Matthias Mann]] on the mass spectrometric analysis of protein complexes, externally supervised by [[Michael Karas]].<ref>{{cite thesis|url=https://d-nb.info/961691492 |title=Proteomanalyse an Multiproteinkomplexen durch Massenspektrometrie, Bioinformatik und Molekularbiologie|publisher=Goethe University Frankfurt|accessdate=2021-12-06|last1=Rappsilber |first1=Juri }}</ref> He followed Mann to the [[University of Southern Denmark]] and completed a [[Postdoctoral researcher|postdoctoral]] fellowship before starting his independent career at IFOM - FIRC Institute for Molecular Oncology, [[Milan]] in 2003. In 2006, he joined the [[Wellcome Trust]] Centre for Cell Biology in the Institute of Cell Biology at the [[University of Edinburgh]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.ed.ac.uk/biology/wcb/research/research-group-leaders/juri-rappsilber|title=Wellcome Centre for Cell Biology, Rappsilber lab |date=2 February 2023 |publisher=WCCB|accessdate=2023-12-17}}</ref> In 2009, he became a senior research fellow of the Wellcome Trust, in 2010 he was appointed Professor of Proteomics in Edinburgh.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.wcb.ed.ac.uk/research/rappsilber|title=Wellcome Senior Research Fellow|publisher=Wellcome Centre for Cell Biology|accessdate=2021-12-06}}</ref> Since 2011, he has been [[Full Professor]] and head of the Chair of Bioanalytics at TU Berlin.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.einsteinfoundation.de/en/people-projects/einstein-professors/juri-rappsilber/|title=Einstein Professors: Juri Rappsilber|publisher=[[Einstein Foundation Berlin]]|accessdate=2021-12-06}}</ref>

==Research==

Rappsilber's interests are focused on combining chemistry and [[computer science]] with biological mass spectrometry to expand the current knowledge on how cells work.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.tu.berlin/en/research/translate-to-english-themenportal-forschen/2020/mai/our-labs-in-focus-rappsilber-laboratory/|title=The Rappsilber Laboratory analyses the structure and interaction of proteins in their natural environment|publisher=TU Berlin|accessdate=2021-12-06}}</ref> His lab is working on novel methods for identifying and quantifying the interactions and the accurate sites of interaction of [[protein]]s with other proteins, [[DNA]] and [[RNA]]. As a central tool they have pioneered crosslinking mass spectrometry. Technologically, they bridge [[organic chemistry]], [[protein chemistry|protein]] & [[nucleotide]] chemistry, [[molecular biology]], separation sciences, mass spectrometry, [[data visualisation]], [[Computer programming|programming]] and [[machine learning]]. Their vision is to reveal the dynamic structure and interactions of every protein in a cell, in a time-resolved manner.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.rappsilberlab.org/research/|title=Research: Overview|publisher=Rappsilber Laboratory|accessdate=2021-12-06}}</ref>

==Awards==

* 2023 [[European Research Council|ERC]] Synergy Grant TransFORM<ref>{{cite web|url=https://erc.europa.eu/sites/default/files/2023-10/erc-2023-syg-results-all-domains.pdf|title=List of ERC Synergy Grants 2023|accessdate=2023-12-17}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.tu.berlin/en/go243064/|title=Juri Rappsilber receives the highest level of funding from the European Research Council (ERC)|publisher=TU Berlin|accessdate=2024-01-30}}</ref>
* 2023 TU Berlin Award for exemplary teaching<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.tu.berlin/lehren/preis-fuer-vorbildliche-lehre-2023|title=TU Berlin Teaching Awards 2023|accessdate=2023-12-17}}</ref>
* 2023 Mass Spectrometry in the Life Sciences Award of the German Mass Spectrometry Society (Deutsche Gesellschaft für Massenspektrometrie, DGMS)<ref>{{cite web|url=https://dgms.eu/en/awards-presented-by-dgms/awardees/awardees-ms-in-den-biowissenschaften/|title=DGMS Life Sciences Awards|accessdate=2023-12-17}}</ref>
* 2021 Elected [[EMBO Member]]<ref>{{cite web|url=https://people.embo.org/profile/juri-rappsilber|title=Juri Rappsilber|publisher=European Molecular Biology Organization (EMBO)|accessdate=2021-12-06}}</ref>
* 2020 EuPA Crosslinking Mass Spectrometry Award<ref>{{cite web|url=https://eupa.org/awards-for-mid-career-scientist/|title=EuPA Awards|accessdate=2023-12-17}}</ref>
* 2009 Senior Research Fellow of the Wellcome Trust<ref>{{cite web|url=https://wellcome.org/grant-funding/people-and-projects/grants-awarded/proteomics-wellcome-trust-centre-cell-biology-school|title=Multi-user Equipment Grants|publisher=Wellcome Trust|accessdate=2021-12-06}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://wellcome.org/grant-funding/people-and-projects/grants-awarded/protein-structures-context-time-space-by-mass|title=Senior Research Fellowships|publisher=Wellcome Trust|accessdate=2021-12-06}}</ref>
* 2005 [[Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions|Marie Curie Excellence Fellow]]
* 2001 Marie Curie Fellow
